pairs.registryProposal: oracle-frozen-during-repair lists a ratchet baseline as oracle and treats a same-commit edit as softening, but a symmetric ratchet cannot record a real fall except by editing that baseline; the release valve should name a reviewed re-baseline rather than forbid it.
